reviews.title: Effective cooling in a simple package
reviews.comment:
This replaced a Thermalright air cooler that couldn’t quite keep my 5800x3d cool enough under heavy load. I was thermal throttling while loading maps in Ready or Not and shader compilation in Helldivers 2 and STALKER 2, and decided it was time to go back to liquid cooling.
This thing impressed me; during benchmarking and stress testing after the install I never saw my processor package temp go above 75C. It’s fairly quiet too, even with the fans spooling up as temperatures increase. Install was painless too, the fans being preinstalled saves time and it comes with a small tube of thermal paste. My one complaint was that I couldn’t get the MSI logo aligned properly with the motherboard orientation using the supplied AM4/5 brackets, it’s on the side instead of the bottom as it should be.
If you’re on the fence, you can’t go wrong here. It’s a solid AIO with good features and solid performance at a very reasonable price.
reviews.author: Terry Garland

reviews.title: Easy to plug and play
reviews.comment: Was very easy to put in and get it going onto the CPU and into the case. I love the daisy chain system that has been added as well making my life easier and coming daisy chained together already. Very quiet and keeping my computer nice and chill.
